PROVISIONAL · TASK 276 · AUTHOR-REPORTED RESULTS
Nano-Phys renders a supplied pendulum period

Six held-out real images. Three seeds per main arm. 12 of 18 Nano-Phys attempts passed motion QC and matched the supplied period within 10%.

Plain Nano
1 / 18

passed QC and within 10%

4/18 passed motion QC
Accepted-clip median P/P_real: 0.680

Nano-Phys
12 / 18

passed QC and within 10%

12/18 passed motion QC
Accepted-clip median P/P_real: 1.011

Wrong-period control
1 / 6

passed motion QC

Supplied 1.7 × real period; seed 1 only
Accepted-clip median ratio: 1.596

12/12 describes accepted clips. Six Nano-Phys attempts failed QC. All 12 accepted outputs came from four of the six scenes. The wrong-period narrative's 1.73 median includes three clips that fail strict QC.

Conditional transfer: real-video period estimates were supplied to the proxy. This benchmark does not establish period recovery from the first image. Reported median luminance flicker: 0.0071 for Nano-Phys, 0.0128 for plain. NVIDIA scoreboard coverage remains pending.

Source: task276 / a33fc5a · Full readout and evidence links
